ops.title: Share current compiler cache across independent Watchman pull requests
ops.description:
Owner /root/watchman_full_suite_delivery. Future CI efficiency, independent of the completed installed native repair. No new workflow/run/config/coverage action until Root resource admission.

Actual41342647125 completed build in58m26s. sccache0.14/GHAC was configured:1504C/C++ requests,141hits,1363misses(9.38%),0read errors/timeouts;5write errors have UNKNOWN specific cause. Long compile, not a proved stall. PR2has1368entries; PR3created1359, with93/100sampled keys/sizes duplicated. Base main has0entries. Actual default host-pressure/no-periodic-clock-20261026 has1432legacy entries that were accessed; sampled repeated key absent there, present inPR3 with same cache version. Earlier default-main label is corrected. GitHub merge-ref cache isolation prevents sibling PR reuse. getdeps prefers sccache onPATH; backend is working.

Next executable step: prepare an isolated trusted-base/main cache-seeding source change, independently review it, preserve complete PR Mac coverage and existing cache trust, then obtain Root runner admission before deployment/verification. Avoid untrusted pull_request_target cache writes, credential expansion, default-branch settings changes or periodic churn. Verify current reusable entries and actual fresh-ref hits/timing before closure; do not attribute all build time or explain the5write errors without evidence.

Raw metadata/default/key probes, final stats and launcher source are in FE/f5c-full-suite-delivery/age-file-subwatcher-lifetime-source/current-build-cache-check. Official contracts: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/dependency-caching and https://docs.github.com/en/rest/actions/cache.
